meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Provisional on release; partially revised with the next quarter's release and revised again later. DBIE keeps the first and the latest version of recent quarters; both are kept.
meta.product: International investment position of India, BPM6 (DBIE report 982)
meta.coverage: International investment position: what India owns abroad and owes to the world, by instrument and sector, in rupees
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 982, ₹ crore, stocks at the end of each quarter (plotted at the quarter's first month). The BPM6 classification, from December 2017. Net position = assets minus liabilities; a negative net position means India owes the world more than it owns abroad.
